It’s not hard to tell when a man truly loves a woman…

He starts treating her like she’s small—like his tiny piece of joy, the kind he’d happily slip into his pocket and carry everywhere… something delicate, precious, effortlessly cherished.

He calls her “little one.”  
Handles her with care, as if she’s small.  
Carries her in his arms like a child.  
Kisses her nose the way you’d kiss a little girl.  
Fears hurting her, as though she might break.  
Wipes her tears gently, the way you comfort a child—his heart crumbling at the sight, helpless, just like when a baby cries.  
Buys her toys, just for fun.  
Brings her candy and ice cream for no reason.  
Feeds her from a spoon.  
Tucks her in under the blanket.  
Looks after her like she couldn’t survive without him.  
Forgives her everything—as only one would forgive a child.

And yet, he fears losing her more than anything…  
as if she were the biggest, most priceless thing in his life.
